title: ‎م‎ e ‎ل, the bindingلا, the article and the šadda

blocks.text: With ⁧م⁩ and ⁧ل⁩ you can write the article ⁧الـ⁩ , the most frequent word of Arabic. Learn when his l is pronounced and when he assimilates to the next consonant, and as the šadda Mark the double consonants: two rules you will use in each line you will read.

rows: 6–7 hours · one week at a standard pace

blocks.text: Materials This unit, calligraphy L0-04, Anki deck (tag L0-04)
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize, pronounce and write ⁧م⁩ and ⁧ل⁩ in all forms, and binding ⁧لا⁩ ;
2. write and read the article ⁧الـ⁩ with moon and solar letters;
3. read and write the šadda, also with vowels;
4. read wa-l- and the fall of the article a after a vowel;
5. read, write and translate the words of the vocabulary.

chapters.title: 1. The two letters and the binding

blocks.text: • Sound. /m/, bilabial nasal: closed lips, air from the nose. It's the Italian m.
• Tracked. A small closed eyelet that rests on the line. Isolate and final add a tail that
She goes down vertically below the line.
• Examples ⁧مِيلَانُو⁩ Mīlānū (initial) · ⁧يَوْم⁩ yawm (isolated after ⁧و⁩ ) · ⁧مُمْتَاز⁩ mumtāz (initial and median).
• Typical error. Forget the tail of the final shape or make it curved like a ⁧ر⁩ .
• Sound. /l/, light alveolar lateral, like the Italian . In the word only ⁧الله⁩ Allāh, after a or u, l
becomes dark [ɫ]; do not extend this sound to other words.
• Tracked. An auction as high as that of ⁧ا⁩ . Initial and median: rod that connects to the left on the line. Isolated and
final: rod ending in a cup under the row, similar to that of ⁧ن⁩ But without a point.
• Examples ⁧لَيْل⁩ Layl (initial and final) · ⁧بَلَد⁩ balad (medial).
• Typical error. Confuse it with ⁧ا⁩ : ⁧ل⁩ it is linked to the following letter and, at the end of the speech, has the cup; ⁧ا⁩ no yes
I've never been a colleague.

When ⁧ل⁩ is followed by ⁧ا⁩ the two letters must merge in a single form: ⁧لا⁩ (insulated) or ⁧ـلا⁩ (final, after a letter connecting). It is not a new letter: it is ⁧ل⁩ + ⁧ا⁩ , we read lā. Examples: ⁧لَا⁩ lā "No' is equal to or greater than "No'. ⁧مِيلَانُو⁩ Mīlānū (The ligature is in the middle of the word).

The definite article is only one for all genres and numbers, and you always write attached to the word: ⁧الـ⁩ + ⁧بَيْت⁩ = ⁧البَيْت⁩ The house is. There is no definite article: ⁧بَيْت⁩ by itself means "one" house.
2.1 Moon and solar letters
The article is conducted in two ways, depending on the first consonant of the word.
• Moon letters: l is pronounced. ⁧البَيْت⁩ al-bayt, ⁧اليَوْم⁩ al-yawm.
• Solar letters: l is written but not pronounced; the next consonant doubles and brings the šadda.

⁧النُّور⁩ an-nūr, ⁧الدِّين⁩ ad-dīn. The sunshine is the consonants pronounced with the tip or the lamina of the tongue against teeth and alveoli: for this reason the l, which is articulated there, assimilates to them.

rows: ⁧ت ث د ذ ر ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ل ن⁩
⁧ا ب ج ح خ ع غ ف ق ك م ه و ي⁩

blocks.text: The names come from two classic examples: ⁧الشَّمْس⁩ aš-šams The sun is the sole; and ⁧القَمَر⁩ al-qamar For now you need the ones you know: solar ⁧ت ث د ذ ر ز ل ن⁩ , lunar ⁧ب م و ي⁩ .
⁧لَيْل⁩ ⁧اللَّيْل⁩ Solar al-layl: ⁧ل⁩ Article + ⁧ل⁩ of the word
2.2 What's going on?

The ⁧ا⁩ of the article is pronounced only when the word is at the beginning of the sentence. After a word that ends in vowel, the a falls and binds to the previous vowel: ⁧وَ⁩ + ⁧البَيْت⁩ = ⁧وَالبَيْت⁩ wa-l-bayt , not wa-al-bayt. The ⁧ا⁩ It's written. It's a case of alif waṣla, which you will deepen in L0-09.

The šadda ⁧ّ⁩ indicates a double consonant (named): ⁧رَدّ⁩ radd, ⁧مُدَرِّب⁩ Mudarrib. The Italians start off with the advantage: it is the same double of 'fatto' or 'carro', with the consonant hold longer.
• fatḥa is written above the šadda ( ⁧َّـ⁩ ), the ḍamma above the šadda ( ⁧ُّـ⁩ ), the kasra under the šadda or under the letter ( ⁧ِّـ⁩ ),
Depending on the fonts.
• At the end of the word, in pause, the double feels little: radd is pronounced almost In the middle of the word must
be clear: mu-dar-rib.
• šadda changes the meaning: ⁧نَزَلَ⁩ Nazala ... is down... ⁧نَزَّلَ⁩ nazzala 'has sent down'
• The double r is vibrated [r], as in the carrot.
In the adjective ⁧دَوْلِيّ⁩ dawlī International šadda on ⁧ي⁩ final marks the -iyy termination, which in pause
pronunciation -ī. It is the nisba, which you will study in A1-07.

Oral production
1. Assimilation. Read the section table 2.1 covering the pronunciation column; Then check.
2. Double. Read mudarrib, nazzala, ar-radd holding the double consonant as in .
3. Ligament. Read bayt wa-l-bayt, nūr wa-n-nūr, without a break between wa and the article.
4. Registration. Recorded time reading; Check the assimilations and doubles.
